wargear.name: Prospero sigil-charm
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Prospero sigil-charm has an Invulnerable Save of 5+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.
wargear.summary: A tiny glyph-etched amulet, renewed every dawn by a cabal scribe.

wargear.name: Fate-glass
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Fate-glass adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic and 1 to its Intelligence Characteristic.
wargear.summary: A lens of cut crystal through which a sorcerer glimpses a few seconds of the next minute.

wargear.name: Warp-touched banner
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Warp-touched banner adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic and 1 to its Intelligence Characteristic.
wargear.summary: A standard whose threads shift colour when no one is looking.

wargear.name: Warding-sigil engraving
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Warding-sigil engraving has an Invulnerable Save of 4+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.
wargear.summary: Rune-lines cut into the hull by a Prosperine artisan.

wargear.name: Aegis of Utterances
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Aegis of Utterances has the Spell-Ward Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A tablet of closely-written wards worn at the breast.

wargear.name: Cabal obelisk-key
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Cabal obelisk-key has the Sorcerous Claim Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A small black prism that fixes a patch of ground in the cabal's foresight.

wargear.name: Numerologist's slate
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Numerologist's slate has the Calculated Volley Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A wax slate scored with firing solutions, carried by the squad's sergeant.

wargear.name: Banner of Shifting Hues
wargear.text: Each Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Banner of Shifting Hues has the Dizzying Hues Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A standard whose colours crawl and never settle.

wargear.name: Mirage lacquer
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Mirage lacquer has the Mirage Lacquer Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A prismatic coating laid over hull plates by Prosperine artisans.

wargear.name: Blade-song glyph
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Blade-song glyph has the Blade-song Rhythm Special Rule.
wargear.summary: A resonant rune cut into the guard of a blademaster's sword.

wargear.name: Codex of Unwritten Days
wargear.summary: A book whose pages fill in the future, always a little before it arrives.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Codex of Unwritten Days has the Foretold Doom Special Rule.

wargear.name: Corvid-pinion mantle
wargear.summary: A cloak of black-and-crimson feathers that stirs without wind.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Corvid-pinion mantle has the Pinion Veil Special Rule.

modifiers.text: Banner of Shifting Hues: Dizzying Hues.
Codex of Unwritten Days: Foretold Doom.

rules.name: Warp Rift Arrival
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Deep Strike Special Rule. When a Unit made up entirely of Models with this Special Rule makes a Deep Strike, the remaining Models in the Unit may be placed within 9" of the first Model placed, instead of within 6".
rules.summary: The host steps out of the warp wherever the Changer of Ways pleases.

rules.name: Cabal Bladework
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule treats the Breaching (5+) Special Rule on its Achea pattern force sword or Paired Achea pattern force sword as Breaching (4+).
rules.summary: Every cut of the blade-cabal is a lesson in where the armour is thinnest.

rules.name: Foresight
rules.text: After both players have deployed and before the first Battle Turn begins, each Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule may make one Set-up Move of up to 6".
rules.summary: The cabal has already seen where the battle will be decided.

rules.name: Spell-Ward
rules.text: Once per Battle, when an enemy Unit makes a Psychic attack against a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule, the Controlling Player may declare that the Unit ignores all effects of that attack.
rules.summary: A tablet of wards turns aside one hostile working.

rules.name: Sorcerous Claim
rules.text: When a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule is counted for Controlling an Objective, it counts as having two additional Models for the purposes of determining Tactical Strength.
rules.summary: A patch of ground the cabal has already foreseen holding.

rules.name: Calculated Volley
rules.text: If a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule remained Stationary in the previous Movement Phase, add 1 to the Hit Tests of Shooting Attacks that Unit makes with Weapons that have the Bolt Trait.
rules.summary: Every shot is plotted on the slate before the trigger is touched.

rules.name: Dizzying Hues
rules.text: When an enemy Unit declares a Charge against a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule, that Unit subtracts 2 from its Charge Roll.
rules.summary: The banner's colours crawl across the eye until the charge loses its line.

rules.name: Mirage Lacquer
rules.text: When an enemy Unit makes a Shooting Attack against a Vehicle with this Special Rule from more than 18" away, subtract 1 from the Hit Tests.
rules.summary: A shimmering lacquer makes the hull seem to stand a little to the left of where it is.

rules.name: Blade-song Rhythm
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic during the first Initiative Step of each Combat.
rules.summary: The glyph hums, and the blade falls to its beat.

rules.name: Sage-King of Prospero
rules.summary: Before the burning, he ruled with a scholar's patience: quick of mind and light of hand.
rules.text: Once per Battle, when this Model is Engaged in a Challenge, the Controlling Player may declare Foreseen Blow and add 3 to this Model's Focus Roll. This Model subtracts 1 from its Strength Characteristic.

rules.name: Unbound Sorcerer-King
rules.summary: He stops holding the Great Ocean back, and it answers, and it takes its share of him.
rules.text: At the start of each of its Controlling Player's Shooting Phases, the Controlling Player may choose one enemy Unit within 18" of this Model and in its line of sight. That Unit suffers three Hits, each with a Strength of 5, an AP of 3, a Damage Characteristic of 1 and the Psychic Trait. If the Controlling Player does so, this Model cannot make a Shooting Attack in that Battle Turn. This Model subtracts 1 from its Toughness Characteristic.

rules.name: Tutor of the Cabal
rules.summary: For a battle he teaches rather than strikes, and his sons stand the straighter for it.
rules.text: Models in friendly Thousand Sons Units within 12" of this Model add 1 to their Cool Characteristic when making Cool Checks. This Model subtracts 2 from its Attacks Characteristic.

rules.name: Foretold Doom
rules.summary: The page was written before the enemy had marched.
rules.text: Once per Battle, at the start of any Battle Turn, the Controlling Player may choose one enemy Unit within 24" of this Model. That Unit must make a Cool Check, and a Unit that fails gains the Suppressed Tactical Status.

rules.name: Pinion Veil
rules.summary: Wings of stolen feathers that are never quite where the blow lands.
rules.text: Models in an enemy Unit that declares a Charge against this Model subtract 1 from the result of their Charge Roll.

rites.name: Host of Change
rites.flavor: The Cabal stopped asking what the Changer of Ways wanted, and began to give it room.
benefits: Flamers and Screamers of Tzeench may fill Troops slots.
Horrors, Flamers and Screamers of Tzeench gain Warp Rift Arrival: Deep Strike, with the rest of the Unit placed within 9" of the first Model instead of 6".
limitations: At least one Horrors of Tzeench unit must start the battle in Reserve.
At least two Horror Squads and one Herald of Tzeench or Prosperine Sorcerer are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Breacher or Assault Squads.

modifiers.text: Host of Change: Warp Rift Arrival.

require.note: Bring at least two Horrors of Tzeench.
A Herald or Prosperine Sorcerer must lead the host.

rites.name: Khenetai Ascendant
rites.flavor: The blade-cabal is where the Legion keeps its pride, and a Legion's pride is rarely kept quiet.
benefits: Khenetai Occult Cabals and Sekhmet Terminator Cabals may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Cabal Bladework: Breaching (4+) on their Achea pattern force swords instead of Breaching (5+).
limitations: At least two Khenetai Occult Cabals are required.
No Armour units and no Support units other than Apothecaries and Techmarines.

require.note: Bring at least two Khenetai Occult Cabals.

rites.name: The Scrying Cabal
rites.flavor: The Legion that has foreseen the battle does not need the biggest guns, only the best-placed.
benefits: Numerologist Cabals and Ammitara Occult Intercession Cabals may fill Troops slots.
They gain Foresight: after deployment and before the first turn, each may make a free 6" Set-up Move.
Every Thousand Sons Infantry unit gains +1 Willpower.
limitations: Every Thousand Sons Infantry unit loses 1 Move.
A Prosperine Sorcerer, Ahzek Ahriman or Magistus Amon must be in the army.
No Armour, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units.

require.note: A Prosperine Sorcerer, Ahriman or Amon must read the omens.

armyRules.name: Weavers of Fate
armyRules.flavor: Cabal sorcerers read the next heartbeat and lean on it.
benefits: Once per Battle Turn, a Model with this Special Rule may add 1 to the result of one Hit Test, Wound Test or Saving Throw made for its Unit.
drawbacks: If the test is still failed after the modifier, the Model suffers 1 Wound, and no Saving Throws or Damage Mitigation Tests may be made against it.

armyRules.name: Wards of Prospero
armyRules.flavor: A scribed ward sits under the plate of every battle-brother.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule that has no Invulnerable Save has an Invulnerable Save of 6+.
drawbacks: The ward gives no protection against Wounds caused by Weapons with the Force Special Rule or by Psychic attacks.

armyRules.name: Capricious Warp
armyRules.flavor: Warp-spawned allies shrug off blows that would fell flesh, but heed the cabal only when it stands near.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule.
drawbacks: While no friendly Prosperine Sorcerer, Herald of Tzeench, Ahzek Ahriman, Magistus Amon or Magnus the Red is within 12" of its Unit, every Model in the Unit subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic.
armyRules.condition: while more than 12" from a friendly sorcerer, Herald or Primarch

armyRules.name: The Crimson King's Regard
armyRules.flavor: Where the Crimson King looks, the Cabal's work grows sure and bright.
benefits: While Magnus the Red is on the battlefield, friendly Thousand Sons Infantry Models within 12" of him add 1 to their Willpower Characteristic.
drawbacks: If Magnus the Red is removed as a casualty, every friendly Thousand Sons Model subtracts 1 from its Willpower Characteristic for the remainder of the Battle.
